subject: general
question:
**In the sentence identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

There are much advantages of working together in a group.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **much advantages**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Replace** 'much' **with **'many'** to make the sentence correct.
 
• **Advantages **(plural noun) means something that may help you to do better than other people.
 
• **Much **is used to describe mass nouns or noncount nouns like juice, rice, patience, and happiness.
 
• When using **much**, the noun will always be **singular**; it cannot be plural.
 
 
• **Example -** *I don't have **much **time left to finish the assignment.*
 
 
 
• **Many **is used to describe count nouns or nouns that can be counted like books, ideas, leaves, and shoes.
 
• When using **many**, the noun will always be **plural**.
 
• You can use **many **with a noncount noun only if you are talking about different types, kinds, or measured quantities of something.
 
 
• **Example -** *There are so **many **things to do I don’t know if we will get them all done.*
 
 
 
• *​*In the given sentence, "**advantages**" is mentioned so, '**many**' should be used as it refers to a plural noun.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**, which contains an error.

**Corrected sentence:** *There are **many **__advantages of working together in a group.*
